articles.title: Costa Rican diplomat emerges as strong contender to be first female head of UN
articles.highlight: 一位父母是大屠杀难民、曾任副总统的哥斯达黎加外交官，意外成为联合国首位女秘书长的领跑者。
articles.summary: 文章报道了雷贝卡·格林斯潘成为联合国秘书长候选人中的意外领跑者。她目前领导联合国贸发会议，被视为连续性候选人并获现任秘书长古特雷斯的默许支持。若当选，她将成为联合国首位女性秘书长，其个人背景与当前国际议题也引人关注。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点：格林斯潘的难民家庭背景和贸发会议经验，可能塑造她在巴以经济议题上的立场；‘连续性’定位既是优势，也可能被要求改革者视为短板。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Rebeca Grynspan seen as continuity candidate with tacit support from current secretary general, António Guterres A Costa Rican diplomat and former vice-president whose parents were refugees from the Holocaust has become the surprise frontrunner to lead the United Nations as its first female secretary general. Rebeca Grynspan, whose parents emigrated to Central America from Poland – and whose maternal grandparents were killed by the Nazis – is the current head of the UN conference on trade and development (UNCTAD), a body that has exhaustively tallied the economic damage inflicted by Israel’s occupation of the Palestinian territories.

articles.title: KunAgent/Kun
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 该项目是一个本地优先的AI智能体工作空间，将编程、写作、设计、研究和自动化整合到一个统一运行时中，并同时提供桌面GUI和TUI界面。它在GitHub上获得6005颗星且近期活动活跃，表明社区关注度高，值得了解其如何平衡本地优先与多功能集成。
articles.failureAnalysis: 本地优先定位虽有利隐私保护，却对大模型推理的硬件要求很高，普通用户门槛较大。功能横跨多个专业领域，可能难以与各领域成熟工具竞争，且缺少明确的用户增长与商业化证据，长期维护的可持续性存疑。

articles.title: Prism-Shadow/penguin-harness
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 这是一个在 GitHub 上获得 1063 星标的开源项目，宣称能让用户一键创建可自我进化的 AI 智能体，并集成 DeepSeek/Kimi/GPT/Claude/Gemini 等多种模型。它值得关注是因为定位恰好反映了非技术用户对“自动化构建、持续演进”的低门槛需求，同时多模型接入展示了工程上的务实取舍，但“自进化”机制的实际效果仍需要验证。

articles.sourceExcerpt: AI-Based Sound Effect Generation: A Narrative Review of Generative Models Across Input Modalities Sandy Abdo[0009−0006−5128−1625] , Bill Kapralos[0000−0003−0434−3847] , Priyamvada Tripathi[0009−0005−5070−7420] , KC Collins[0000−0003−0695−7228] , and Adam Dubrowski[0000−0002−2074−0933] AbstractSound effects play a crucial role in conveying actions, events, and environ- mental cues across digital applications, often requiring a high degree of variation and contextual adaptability. Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven audio generative models are rapidly growing in popularity and have the potential to transform the way sound is synthesized and used across various applications. In response to this growing momen- tum, this chapter reviews and analyzes recent AI-based generative models for sound effect synthesis, with a focus on how different input modalities (text, visual, audio, and multimodal) affect the quality, controllability, and contextual relevance of the gener- ated audio.
